text:
Aisha: hitting a weird import error in the NextStarter + LlamaIndex sample when running on edge. prompt utils import returns undefined.
Marc: ah ok. is that the sample shipped in sample-starters repo?
Aisha: yes, examples/next-starter-llamaindex. Browser console shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'buildPrompt')`.
Devon (devex): likely packaging mismatch. Did we publish only ESM (index.mjs) but package.json main points to dist/index.cjs.js?
Ling: checked the packaged tarball — dist/index.mjs exists, dist/index.cjs.js missing. d.ts points at src types, IDE resolves to wrong surface.
Aisha: repro steps: pnpm i, pnpm dev in example, open /eval, send prompt -> immediate failure.
Marc: short-term fix: update package.json to include "module" + "main" + "exports" map and ensure rollup outputs both cjs and esm.
Devon (devex): SDK parity note: node sdk will silently reconnect streams on 401, browser SDK throws. For the sample we should add an auth wrapper that retries token refresh and falls back to non-streaming mode with a user-visible warning.
Ling: I'll open a publishing patch to restore cjs entry and correct types.
ci-bot: CI run 624 failed — examples/next-starter-llamaindex e2e stream.spec.ts expected stream to continue after token rotate but got 401.
Aisha: thanks. also propose adding a pnpm pack check in CI to assert both entrypoints are in the tarball.
Marc: agreed. action items: ling/package-fix, devon/auth-wrapper-fallback, marc/pack-ci. I'll take the pack-check GH action.
Devon (devex): I'll draft the auth wrapper that does up to 2 optimistic refresh attempts and toggles non-stream fallback for CI.
Aisha: leaving a short checklist in the example dir and will add a README note about edge cold-start ephemeral key caveat. :thumbsup:
